Clean Data¶

src.clean.clean_data(data)¶

Clean applicant records sequentially while preserving input order.

Records that already contain standardized program and university values are retained without further processing. For other records, canonical program and university lookups are performed first, and the LLM is called only for fields that do not have canonical matches.

Processing progress and LLM usage statistics are printed while the records are being cleaned. A final summary is printed after all records have been processed.

Parameters:

data (list) – Applicant records to clean.

Returns:

Cleaned applicant records in their original input order.

Return type:

list

src.clean.load_data(input_path, limit=None)¶

Load applicant records from a JSON file.

The input may either be a list of records or a dictionary containing the records under a "rows" key. An optional limit can restrict processing to the first specified number of records.

Parameters:

  • input_path (str) – Path to the JSON input file.

  • limit (int or None) – Maximum number of records to load, or None to load all records.

Returns:

Loaded applicant records.

Return type:

list

Raises:

ValueError – If the loaded JSON value is neither a list nor a dictionary containing a "rows" list.

src.clean.save_cleaned_data(data, output_path)¶

Safely save cleaned applicant data to a JSON file.

The records are first written to a temporary file and then moved into place with os.replace. This reduces the risk of losing the previous output file if the process fails while writing the new data.

Parameters:

  • data (list) – Cleaned applicant records to save.

  • output_path (str) – Destination path for the cleaned JSON data.
